title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0：自动化任务构建与衡量智能体持续进展
summary: LHTB 2.0 扩展了长时程终端基准，包含13个领域77个任务，通过重建任务流水线自动生成任务，并将评估时长延长至3小时、每30分钟记录检查点，以密集进度阶梯奖励部分进展。实验显示仅看最终结果会丢弃大量中间进展。
summary_en: LHTB 2.0 extends the long-horizon terminal benchmark with 77 tasks across 13 domains, using a reconstruction pipeline to auto-generate tasks, extending evaluation to 3 hours with 30-minute verifier checkpoints and dense progress ladders that reward partial progress. Results show outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress.
